name: MOIL Ltd
about: MOIL Ltd is primarily engaged in mining of manganese ore and is the largest manganese ore producer in the country.[1] It is a miniratna state-owned company owned by Govt. of India.[2]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is the largest producer of manganese ore with a market share of 53% in India with large reserves of manganese ore. It is the only producer of Electrolytic Manganese Dioxide. [1] [2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 34.0%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.87% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.8% over last 3 years.
